Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: portrait environment illustration for the PEAK Trail fan website's daily biome gallery, 2:3 aspect ratio.
Primary request: SHORE — communicate the distinctive first coastal climbing biome, as an atmospheric illustration rather than a game screenshot or 3D map.
Scene: a warm sandy shore beneath towering ochre coastal cliffs, irregular climbable rock stacks receding upward, quiet turquoise ocean curling around the rocks, a few wind-bent coastal palms and olive grass on the upper ledges. Look into the landscape from near the shore; the cliffs invite an ascent.
Style: premium hand-painted adventure-book cover, matte gouache-like color masses, softly faceted rock shapes, subtle fine paper grain, carefully edited detail, cinematic atmospheric depth. Playful adventurous spirit compatible with PEAK, but no copied UI or exact map layout.
Composition: a single immersive full-bleed scene, portrait 2:3, strong readable silhouettes, principal landmark in upper two-thirds, quiet darker foreground in bottom fifth for HTML text overlay; edges naturally darken into a forest-charcoal website. Warm sun catches upper cliffs against muted teal air. Rich yet restrained, elegant rather than technical.
Constraints: NO text, NO letters, NO logos, NO watermark, NO people, NO UI, NO chart, NO isometric diorama, NO floating island, NO render of a miniature model, NO black borders, no divided panels. One finished illustration.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: corrected PEAK Trail homepage biome illustration, portrait 2:3.
Input image 1: EDIT TARGET, the current volcano illustration. Its mountain-like terrain is WRONG and must change. Preserve its premium hand-painted gouache adventure-book-cover style, fine paper texture, restrained atmospheric color palette, painterly material detail and dark calm lower fifth for HTML copy. Preserve the portrait aspect ratio and lack of text, people, borders and UI.
Primary correction: CALDERA / 火山, the OUTDOOR fourth stage. The actual map is a broad nearly LEVEL lava plain dotted with many small rocky islands, low rounded basalt mounds and a few modest rocky knolls. Main ground elevation stays essentially constant from foreground into the distance. Horizontal molten-orange channels weave between dark grey flat rock stepping ledges on one common level. Keep just a FEW SMALL hills interrupting a LOW horizon, much wider than high; none exceeds about one eighth of frame height. Subtle ash and heat haze, dim orange reflected light. No climbing mountain composition.
Composition: view across a broad horizontal landscape from a slightly raised human viewpoint, not from the bottom of a canyon. An open sky / mist band and clearly LOW horizon should establish flatness. Foreground and distant ground form one shared plane, with depth created by overlap and atmospheric fading rather than tall cliffs. Fill the portrait with sky, low terrain and foreground, NOT by stacking mountains vertically. The terrain is flat overall, not a mathematically featureless floor: local small hills and low rock obstacles remain. Keep the style consistent with the edit target while rebuilding its terrain silhouette completely.
Critical exclusions: REMOVE ALL giant vertical rock walls, huge mesas, needle spires, steep terraced mountain ranges, deep ravines, waterfall-like lava drops, elevated lava cascades, volcano cones, tower-like mountains and interior shafts. No castles or temple finale. No text, people, logo, watermark, map, grid, miniature model, or isometric diorama. This is an evocative biome atmosphere image, not a literal exact daily map.
